title: Pre-render check gate rules
what_it_does: Rules brag attaches to hyperframes check: contrast failures are errors, 0/0 text checks means contrast is unverified, oklch colors must become hex, and no per-element bypass.
when_to_use: When a launch composition passes check but shows no audited text; add as a post-check warning.
why: The rules are short and already fit our check step; reimplement the 0/0 coverage warning ourselves instead of copying text.
